name: Onigashima Houou
source:
"Guys, fighting is great and all, but be sure to stick to your principles."

[Class] Third Year Kirigumi (Paulownia)
[Personality] Cheerful, Unprecedented
[Specialty] Judo

The [url=/c39873]heroine[/url] and [url=/c39879]Hikaru's[/url] older brother, born of a different mother, but the details are unknown. Ever since a young age he lived separately from Hikaru and has a prejudice against him. Entering Shishiku Academy, according to the customs of the Onigashima family, he carries the legend of ruling the school within a month.

[Translation taken from [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2015/11/14/kenka-banchou-otome/]Otome Jikan[/url]]
